meta.coverage: All 41 Harrow primary/infant/junior schools in Harrow Council's 2026-27 guide, plus Wembley Primary where a current 2026 open-day schedule is published.
meta.note: School catalog is authoritative to the Harrow guide; open-event dates are checked separately against school websites, calendars, council pages and other corroborating sources. Unknown current dates are not labelled TBC.
